payload.body: dc is applying intent claude upgrade --apply in this checkout now (ST0001/01). It writes .claude/settings.json (SessionStart context, the strict UserPromptSubmit gate that blocks a session's first prompt until /in-session runs, the Stop reminder, and a deny on editing AGENTS.md), .mcp.json (Intent's MCP server), AGENTS.md, usage-rules.md, .intent_critic.yml and the pre-commit, post-merge, post-checkout and post-rewrite git hooks. From then on every commit here runs the gate: the shipped guards, intent critic on the staged rust and shell files, and intent doctor; a finding, a refusing guard or a doctor exit 1 refuses the commit. The gate body runs from /Users/matts/Devel/prj/Intent, not brew's 3.2.8.
